kevin: Big news 1 389 We officially closed $10M ARR this quarter!!
anya: 💯🔥 absolute unit achievement. drinks + ramen?
lee: ramen yes. karaoke later?
sarah: Karaoke is non-negotiable. i'll bring the air guitar.
kevin: who wants merch? limited edition tee idea: "Redwood Inference: Ten Million and Counting"
anya: voting: :tshirt: for tee, :sticker: for sticker, :none: for just cake
lee: :sticker: sticker > tee (less laundry)
kevin: plan: in-office ramen bar w/ vegan options Thursday 5pm, remote folks get snack stipend
hr-bot: Reminder: submit expense requests for team celebrations within 7 days
sarah: shoutout to sales + customer success for that enterprise deal. and infra for the smooth launch last month.
kevin: shoutout to runtime team 4AA caching & batching magic
deploy-bot: DEPLOYMENT: rollout "enterprise-2026-q1" completed at 2026-03-22T16:03Z 
anya: tiny video idea: montage of deploy logs + confetti gif. can someone stitch?
lee: i can do a 30s clip, need screenshots and a silly soundtrack
kevin: soundtrack suggestion: 'we are the champions' or 'work hard play hard'
sarah: yes to champions. also can we get a plaque for reception? small plaque that says "10M ARR - Teamwork & Tiny Snacks"
anya: petition for commemorative mochi too
lee: petition seconded. mochi > cupcakes
kevin: created 10M-arr event on calendar for Thursday 17:00 PT
hr-bot: Event created: "10M ARR Ramen + Karaoke" 0E0 Tomorrow 5:00 PM PT
anya: sending a short kudos thread to #all in the morning, please add your shoutouts
sarah: huge thanks everyone. gonna cry happy tears later
lee: quick poll: karaoke song picks? drop one emoji with song title in thread
kevin: ok back to shipping, but savor this for 30 seconds. proud of y'all. ❤️
